title: Rearranging formulae: move all terms to one side
metacognition_prompt: Before you start, what single skill is this repair problem checking?

source_reference.notes: Called by Q-016 Q016_CONSECUTIVE_SETUP. Atomicity=alg.rearranging_formulae; Scenario=Called by Q-016 Q016_CONSECUTIVE_SETUP; Surface variation=yes; No new vocab=yes; Steps=1-2. Edexcel pivot metadata applied.

problem_text: Rewrite x^2 + x = 20 as an equation equal to zero.
student_prompt: Answer this short repair question. Keep your working brief.

error_category_mapping.diagnostic_sentence: If the moved 20 keeps a plus sign, the issue is rearranging to zero without using the inverse operation. Quadratic solving usually begins with this standard form.

hint_ladder.title: Equal zero form
hint_ladder.prompt: To rewrite as equal to zero, move every term to one side and leave 0 on the other side.

hint_ladder.title: Move 20
hint_ladder.prompt: The 20 is on the right, so subtract 20 from both sides.

hint_ladder.title: Sign of moved term
hint_ladder.prompt: Watch the sign when 20 moves to the left side. Subtracting 20 gives a negative constant in the zero form.

hint_ladder.title: Zero-form routine
hint_ladder.prompt: Choose one side for all terms, use inverse operations to move the rest, and check the sign. Apply it here; do not copy.

common_errors: uses the previous larger problem instead of this repair skill
expected_solution_steps.diagnostic_sentence: This repair focuses on moving the constant to the left side with the correct sign so the equation equals zero.
